display_convention.rule: Prefix the visible name of every competition only when official status and the applicable season are verified.

notes: All 52 clubs are fictional original Fútbol Nova entities.
No official Cuban second or third division has been verified for the target season.
No automatic promotion into or relegation from the official Cuban first division is assumed.

club_identity_policy.uniqueness: Club display names must be original and not imitate real club names from the same country.
club_identity_policy.country_authenticity: All clubs retain their Cuban municipality and province as home location.
club_identity_policy.review_scope: Check current and historical clubs, including spelling variants and abbreviations.
club_identity_policy.publishing_gate: Do not publish a club if exact or confusingly similar names, crests, kits, slogans or marks are identified.
club_identity_policy.global_coverage_note: El catálogo actual contiene clubes cubanos. La política mundial se aplica a futuras incorporaciones; no afirmar que todos los clubes del mundo han sido revisados.
